pages.title: Implementum
pages.text: The Implementum ritual gives you an $(bold)Implement:$() a magical tool that you will never lose.$(br2)It is the easiest of the three rituals to perform, but be wary of performing it too early: your Implement is with you forever, and a netherite pickaxe is a better Implement than a stone one.
More information about possible Implements and how they affect you can be found in the Implementum book.
